statements.t: The Company will continue to pay quarterly dividends targeting dividend per share growth in line with Adjusted EPS growth.
The Company expects to resume meaningful share repurchases once it has achieved its target gross leverage of approximately 2.8x.
For the full-year, the Company is updating its outlook, projecting Adjusted revenue growth of 28 - 29%, Adjusted EBITDA growth of 29 - 30% and Adjusted EPS growth of 1.2 - 2.4%.
Additionally, the Company is maintaining its target for Free Cash Flow 1 of $2.15 - $2.25 billion, or growth of 33 - 39% as compared to the prior year.
1 Our 2026 Free Cash Flow outlook is defined as Free cash flow excluding cash transaction taxes on business dispositions, primarily the Worldpay sale.

statements.t: However, we incurred approximately $7.7 billion of new debt upon closing of the Issuer Solutions Acquisition in the first quarter of 2026, as further discussed in Note 7 to the consolidated financial statements, which will increase our interest expense in 2026.

We expect to continue to invest an appropriate level of resources to maintain, enhance and extend the functionality of our proprietary systems and existing software applications, to develop new and innovative software applications and systems to address emerging technology trends in response to the needs of our clients, and to enhance the capabilities of our outsourcing infrastructure.

We expect continued consolidation within the banking industry, primarily in the form of merger and acquisition activity among financial institutions, which generally increases competition among financial technology providers.

To facilitate this expansion, we believe that payment processors will need to enhance their technology platforms so they can deliver these capabilities and differentiate their offerings from other providers.
We believe that these market changes present both an opportunity and a risk for us, and we cannot predict which emerging technologies or solutions will be successful.
Technical solutions that serve many customers are increasingly becoming targets of these kinds of attacks, including direct attacks on our supply chain partners, or our clients.
This is a trend we expect to continue with widespread impacts.

Using expertise we have gained from our ongoing focus and investment, we have developed and we offer fraud, security, risk management and compliance solutions to target this growth opportunity in the financial services industry.

The income approach used discounted cash flow analyses based on management's most recent forecasts, including assumptions regarding projected revenue growth, operating margins, capital expenditures, working capital requirements and terminal growth rates.

We also assessed the reasonableness of the aggregate estimated fair value of the reporting units by comparison to our market capitalization over a reasonable period of time, considering expected acquirer expense synergies and control premiums observed in historical transactions involving payments and financial technology companies.

The estimated fair values of the reporting units are sensitive to changes in management's judgments and estimates, including projected revenue growth, operating margins, capital expenditures, working capital requirements, discount rates and market valuation multiples.
We intend to continue to maintain investment-grade debt ratings.
We currently expect to continue to pay quarterly dividends targeting dividend-per-share growth aligned to adjusted earnings-per-share growth.

Following the closing of the Issuer Solutions Acquisition, the Company has temporarily curtailed repurchases under this program and may resume at management's discretion, taking into account our target leverage ratio.
We expect to continue investing in software and in property and equipment to support our business.

While we expect to continue to invest in acquisitions as part of our strategy to add solutions to help win new clients and cross-sell to existing clients, the Company expects to limit further investment in acquisitions to accelerate deleveraging until it returns to its target leverage ratio.
